summary: Master digital media monetization and audience analytics with practical dashboards, revenue models, and KPI tools. Enrol to apply it immediately.
lede: Audience analytics links content performance and audience behavior to revenue decisions in digital media. For professionals in audience growth, editorial, product, analytics, or commercial reporting, the course develops practical skills in KPI scorecards, retention and cohort analysis, revenue-model mapping, and content test planning. It also covers building reporting workflows with Google Analytics 4 and Looker Studio to communicate audience value and monetization results to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work across audience growth, editorial planning, monetization, analytics, and commercial reporting in digital media. It is most useful when you already handle performance data and need to turn that data into clearer revenue decisions and better stakeholder reporting.
modules: Governance and Reporting for Digital Media
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, access to spreadsheet software, and familiarity with current digital media dashboards. If possible, prepare a recent performance report, a channel dashboard export, or a sample audience dataset for the applied exercises.
